title: No mechanical guard that ticfac never imports or requires a ticks Go package
description:
6in set out to prove the dependency direction mechanically. The contract direction is checked (contracts check/verify-upstream) and ticks pins its removed verbs by test, but ticfac's 'never import a ticks Go package' lives only in .tick/config.md prose; today go.mod requires nothing from pengelbrecht/ticks, but nothing fails if that changes. A whole-repo test asserting go.mod has no github.com/pengelbrecht/ticks require and no package's deps include one closes it cheaply.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding 52c0facb0e60a007e8927e38ef1633e32bcb097caf7d61cc877a5cfc1a0a1a7e (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-v7z/attempt-8): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/52c0facb0e60a007e8927e38ef1633e32bcb097caf7d61cc877a5cfc1a0a1a7e.json on the run branch.
